mapper.delete: DELETE FROM afv_media_access_ticket WHERE expires_at < TIMESTAMPADD(DAY, -1, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) LIMIT 1000
mapper.select: SELECT LEAST(deadline_at, TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE, 60, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))) AS expires_at FROM afv_agent_run WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND actor_team_id <=> #{teamId} AND owner_instance_id = #{owner} AND owner_epoch = #{epoch} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND deadline_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (project_id IS NULL OR #{projectId} IS NULL OR project_id = #{projectId}) FOR UPDATE

SELECT j.deadline_at FROM afv_canvas_text_job j JOIN afv_canvas_run r ON r.id = j.run_id JOIN afv_canvas c ON c.id = r.canvas_id WHERE j.id = #{id} AND j.owner_instance_id = #{owner} AND j.owner_epoch = #{epoch} AND j.status = 'RUNNING' AND j.lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND j.deadline_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND j.cancel_requested = FALSE AND r.cancel_requested = FALSE AND c.archived = FALSE AND r.actor_user_id = #{userId} AND r.actor_team_id <=> #{teamId} AND (#{projectId} IS NULL OR j.project_id = #{projectId})
SELECT * FROM afv_media_access_ticket WHERE token_hash = #{hash} AND resource_id = #{id} AND revoked = FALSE AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM afv_remote_generation_job job JOIN afv_generation_submission submission ON submission.id = job.submission_id WHERE job.id = #{id} AND job.active_attempt_id = #{attemptId} AND job.cancel_requested = FALSE AND job.permit_held = TRUE AND job.deadline_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND job.state IN ('RUNNING','WAITING','UNKNOWN_SUBMISSION','NEEDS_REVIEW') AND job.phase IN ('PREPARING','SUBMITTING','POLLING') AND submission.actor_user_id = #{userId} AND submission.actor_team_id <=> #{teamId} AND (#{projectId} IS NULL OR job.project_id = #{projectId})

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM afv_agent_run WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND actor_team_id <=> #{teamId} AND owner_instance_id = #{owner} AND owner_epoch = #{epoch} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND deadline_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (project_id IS NULL OR #{projectId} IS NULL OR project_id = #{projectId})

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM afv_canvas_text_job j JOIN afv_canvas_run r ON r.id = j.run_id JOIN afv_canvas c ON c.id = r.canvas_id WHERE j.id = #{id} AND j.cancel_requested = FALSE AND r.cancel_requested = FALSE AND c.archived = FALSE AND j.permit_held = TRUE AND j.request_started_at IS NOT NULL AND j.deadline_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND j.status IN ('RUNNING','UNKNOWN_SUBMISSION','NEEDS_REVIEW') AND r.actor_user_id = #{userId} AND r.actor_team_id <=> #{teamId} AND (#{projectId} IS NULL OR j.project_id = #{projectId})
